payload.title: SOP distilled from incident
payload.text:
P-202 Bearing Replacement Procedure
1. Monitor drive-end vibration trends weekly.
2. Investigate if vibration exceeds 3.1mm/s.
3. Confirm outer-race defect if BPFO peak at 142Hz detected.
4. Replace bearings per SOP-12.
5. Verify post-replacement vibration below 2.1mm/s.
6. Document replacement date and vibration readings.
7. Inspect adjacent bearings for wear patterns.
8. Schedule next vibration check in 48 hours.

Verification: Post-repair vibration reading must be below 2.1mm/s with no BPFO peak at 142Hz.
